nodes.title: (input:prompt) Text Prompt
widgets_values:
Live action cinematic.
[Shot 1] Medium shot, eye-level. @char2_front, wearing Grey suit jacket, white collared sharp shirt, dark grey dress pants black leather dress shoes and a black leather belt stands firmly in the rain-slicked alleyway, his body coiled with tension. His arms remain locked tight around @char1_front, who wears White sheer button-up blouse brown mini skirt sheer pantyhose and bare feet; her torso is pressed against his chest as she braces for impact. The camera holds steady on their locked embrace as the initial shockwave of the previous blow settles into their shared breath. Close-up, low angle focusing on @char2_front's face. His eyes squeeze shut tight and his mouth falls open in a ragged inhalation. Water droplets fly from his dark hair as he shakes his head slightly, trying to clear the sting from his ribs. His jaw muscles bunch hard as he forces the air back into his lungs without releasing his grip on @char1_front. Medium shot. The camera tilts down slightly to capture the lower half of @char2_front's frame. His right leg shifts its weight subtly, planting his black leather dress shoe deeper into the wet pavement. He locks his knees, anchoring himself against the upward force building within @char1_front's body. His grey suit jacket pulls tight across his broad back as he maintains his hold. Extreme close-up on the junction of their bodies. The white collared shirt of @char2_front contrasts sharply with the sheer fabric of @char1_front' blouse as her left leg drives upward. Her bare foot, clad only in sheer pantyhose, connects squarely with his groin area. The fabric of his dark grey dress pants ripples visibly at the point of impact, deforming inward under the sudden force. Close-up on @char2_front. His eyes snap open wide, pupils dilated in shock and pain. A guttural sound tears from his throat, transforming into a deep, resonant bellow. Veins stand out on his neck as the breath is knocked violently out of him. His head tilts back slightly against the force, hair whipping forward across his face. Medium two-shot. The camera tracks backward rapidly as @char1_front continues her momentum. She twists her hips sharply to the left while keeping her upper body locked against him. Her brown mini skirt flares outward from the rotation. Her bare toes curl tight as she pivots on her standing leg, using her own weight to torque his torso off-center. Close-up on @char1_front' face. She grits her teeth, her expression fierce and focused. Water drips from her chin as she maintains eye contact with the space just past his shoulder. Her arms remain wrapped tightly around his neck, guiding his fall as her legs complete the twisting motion. Her white button-up blouse wrinkles tightly across her shoulders. Low angle, wide shot. @char2_front buckles at the waist, his knees threatening to give way. He drops heavily onto one knee, his grey suit jacket rumpling around him. His arms are still wrapped around @char1_front' waist, but his grip loosens slightly as his center of gravity shifts downward. Rain pours over them both, blurring the background of brick and shadow.
